reviews_list.body: My friend sent me Aer product from India (4 packs) and i start using it from 09th Feb 2024 (As you can see, I mentioned the date by Pen on the back of the product). Draw Backs i) Their claim for 30-Days is Hollow. It hardly lasts up to 20 Days. ii) From the 2nd day, the middle material (Plastic) sticks to each other, kind of shrinks (1st Picture). iii) During the last few days of products Life (Day 18-19-20), the material got stucked at the bottom (like frost) with almost no fragrance. POSIVITE SIDES i) Handy product with good packaging and nice design. ii) Although the fragrance lasts up to 20 Days but no doubt the fragrance was good, It gives freshly feeling as soon as you step in your car. The Maker should work on it's Working Life and at least make it to 26-27 Days. Thank You
